module: Targeted tests of the Vue startup recovery contract for the router: transition resent every second without limit (startup phase), acknowledgments that serve only as telemetry (routeChangeReceived), resends stopped by routeNavigationStarted, rejection of acknowledgments with a stale transition identifier, identifier kept on cancellation and cleanup of the pending entry. Uses Config, TransitionManager and NavigationState. Run with: extensions.testFramework_TestManager:runTestFiles("transitionRecovery").
notes: The testXxx(ctx) functions are run by testFramework_TestManager; the game does not call them in normal use.

testStartupResendIntervalIsOneSecond.desc: The startup resend interval in Config is one second.

testStartupResendsEverySecondIndefinitel.desc: In the startup phase, the transition is resent every second, indefinitely.

testReceivedDoesNotStopStartupResends.desc: routeChangeReceived is telemetry: it does not stop the resends.

testPostStartTimersResetAfterLongStartup.desc: After a long startup, the end-of-transition timers restart from zero once navigation has started.

testStaleTransitionIdIsRejectedOnProgres.desc: A progress acknowledgment with a stale transition identifier is rejected.

testStaleTransitionIdIsRejectedOnComplet.desc: A completion acknowledgment with a stale identifier is rejected.

testCancelReturnsStartedTransitionId.desc: Cancellation returns the identifier of the started transition (used in the cancellation payload).

testCancelWhenIdleReturnsNilId.desc: Cancelling with no transition in progress returns a nil identifier.

testClearPendingEntryRemovesUncommittedE.desc: NavigationState clears the uncommitted pending entry.
